name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. 'maybe_load' captures the conditional (game-speed-flag gated) load; 'speed_mode_overlay' captures the fast-mode walk-animation overlay resource. No Ghidra address residue. Accurately reflects the body (CMP byte [game_speed_flag]; on non-zero, MOV [overlay_ptr]=0 then = fd2_load_dat_resource(FDOTHER.DAT,0,0x40)).
purpose: Fast-mode gate: when the game-speed (fast mode) flag is set, load the trimmed fast-walk animation overlay (FDOTHER.DAT index 0x40) into the battle overlay handle so AI/enemy turns use the abbreviated walk animation.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x10) stack-probe prologue, then: if (data_fd2_ui_game_speed_flag != 0) { data_fd2_battle_fast_mode_walk_overlay_ptr = NULL; data_fd2_battle_fast_mode_walk_overlay_ptr = fd2_load_dat_resource("FDOTHER.DAT" @0x51A4D, 0, 0x40); }. The intermediate NULL store is a faithful vendor defensive-clear before the assignment (both stores emitted in the binary). When the flag is 0 the overlay pointer is left untouched (stays NULL) and nothing is loaded.

returns.semantics: No return value (RET with no EAX contract). Effect is the side-effect store into data_fd2_battle_fast_mode_walk_overlay_ptr.
